description: Curated YAML component count from the component-id index; must be reported separately from generated object rows.
review_use: Prevents mistaking catalog manifests for total primitives.

description: Number of source-surface scan partitions planned for a run, grouped by surface id, status, risk tier, vertical, and expected object types.
review_use: Shows whether a run is wide enough to cover the intended source-surface backlog.

description: Queue-ready worker job counts and replay-record counts by job type, including discovery, snapshot, page conversion, ingest, entity linking, dedupe, index, and review.
review_use: Identifies missing worker stages and lets operators resume only failed or skipped stages.

description: Counts staged source records, normalized objects, entities, refs, dedupe clusters, labels, dimensions, embeddings, index records, and review tickets.
review_use: Tracks million-object progress without inflating YAML manifests.

description: Counts promotion holds, promotion candidates, review-before-promotion decisions, rejects, promotion review tickets, and promotion index records.
review_use: Shows whether generated candidates are ready for search exposure or still review-gated.

description: Summarizes relationship preflight status, issue count, bulk-load manifest status, load SQL path, and psql load command.
review_use: Tells operators whether a partition batch can be safely loaded into Postgres and pgvector.

description: Reports whether source bodies were fetched, raw private data was stored, insurance scope is excluded, and publication remains review-gated.
review_use: Keeps high-volume runs aligned with public-catalog privacy and provenance constraints.
